title: Kal'ai Ruins

[[Image:Kal'ai Ruins.jpg|thumb|300px|Kal'ai Ruins]]
'''Kal'ai Ruins''' is a collection of ancient [[troll]] ruins found in [[Stranglethorn Vale]] that are now partially submerged. The [[Murkgill tribe]] of [[murloc]]s live in these ruins.
